identity.title: Freeze governance semantic surface after dogfood convergence

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Close the current governance expansion batch by documenting the semantic surface proven through 8065-8068, the remaining evidence-backed gaps, and the explicit freeze rule: no new top-level governance primitive without new production evidence. This pack must not change production or tests.
human_pressure.why_now: The repo has accumulated scoped, temporal, provenance, conformance and regression semantics. The next risk is feature inflation rather than missing capability.
do_not_misread: Freeze means semantic-surface freeze, not bug-fix freeze.
Projection correctness, conformance fixes and dogfood are still allowed.
red_lines: No roadmap item invented without evidence.

machine_core.goal: Create a bounded, evidence-backed freeze record for the current Ailuros governance semantic surface and define what may continue during freeze.
red_lines: Do not rename or redesign existing canonical semantics.
Do not add new dimensions to governance regression.
Do not claim full convergence if 8065-8068 expose unresolved blocking defects.
invariants: Current canonical surface is documented from actual code, not pack titles alone.
Allowed during freeze: producer conformance, projection correctness, evidence attribution, conflict correctness, regression correctness, report quality, dogfood tooling.
Disallowed without new production evidence: new top-level governance primitive, workflow/state engine behavior, new regression scoring dimensions, producer-specific semantics.
Open gaps preserve severity and evidence links.

producer.artifact: completed evidence and findings from 8065-8068 plus current canonical code

observable_effect.assertion: The next development batch is constrained by an explicit evidence-backed semantic freeze instead of feature accumulation.

proofs.assertion: Freeze record cites actual code/tests/dogfood findings and full repository validation remains green.

failure_semantics: If a blocking cross-boundary defect remains, document it as permitted convergence work, not as a reason to invent a new primitive.
If a proposed future capability lacks production evidence, keep it outside committed roadmap.

steps.title: Inventory implemented canonical semantics
details: Use current code/tests as source of truth for identity, authority, approval, budget, scope, validation, lifecycle, outcomes, signals, coverage, provenance, temporal attribution and regression delta.
Do not list pack-only concepts with no code evidence as implemented surface.

steps.title: Record convergence status
details: Summarize 8065 raw producer acceptance, 8066 projection semantics, 8067 real regression proof and 8068 source-neutrality lock.
Separate fixed, open, expected-unknown and insufficient-evidence findings.

steps.title: Write freeze rules
details: Define allowed convergence work and disallowed semantic expansion.
Require new production evidence before a new top-level primitive can enter roadmap.

steps.title: Validate clean baseline
details: Run full suite and record result without changing test expectations.

acceptance: Freeze document reflects actual code and dogfood evidence.
Remaining gaps are explicit and evidence-backed.
No production or test files are modified.

must_check: Implemented surface is derived from code/tests rather than naming alone.
Freeze does not block correctness/conformance fixes.
No new primitive or speculative roadmap is introduced.
reject_if: A pack-only concept is presented as implemented without code evidence.
Open defects are mislabeled as converged.
The freeze rule is weakened to permit speculative feature expansion.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Documentation-only convergence/freeze gate backed by current code and full suite.
